name: parseur
label: Parseur
description: Parseur is a document/email parsing tool that extracts structured data from emails, attachments, PDFs, invoices, forms, etc. It supports dynamic templates and table fields, and delivers parsed output to integrations (e.g. via webhook or API). This integration enables reactive workflows based on new processed documents, failed processing, mailbox changes, and more.

token.label: API Key
token.description: Create a new API key in Account → API keys in the Parseur app: https://app.parseur.com/account/api-keys

getParsedDocumentById.label: Get Parsed Document by ID
getParsedDocumentById.description: Fetch parsed JSON / structured output for a given document ID

body_html.label: Body HTML
body_html.description: The HTML content of the document/email.

body_plain.label: Body Plain
body_plain.description: The plain text content of the document/email.

message_headers.label: Message Headers
message_headers.description: A JSON object representing the email headers (key-value pairs).

reprocessDocument.label: Reprocess Document
reprocessDocument.description: Send an existing document back through parsing (e.g. after updating template).

findDocument.label: Find Document
findDocument.description: Finds a document based on search param.

search.label: Search
search.description: The search term to filter documents by name. Case insensitive. If empty, all documents are returned.

parseur_list_documents.label: List Documents
parseur_list_documents.description: Lists documents in a mailbox, with filters and paging.

mailboxId.label: Mailbox ID
mailboxId.description: Numeric ID of the Parseur mailbox (parser), e.g. "123456". Use List Mailboxes to find it.

search.label: Search
search.description: Case-insensitive partial match on the document name.

status.label: Status
status.description: Only documents in this status. PARSEDOK = parsed, PARSEDKO = failed to parse, QUOTAEXC = out of credits, EXPORTKO = export failed.

receivedAfter.label: Received After
receivedAfter.description: Only documents received after this date, as yyyy-mm-dd.

receivedBefore.label: Received Before
receivedBefore.description: Only documents received before this date, as yyyy-mm-dd.

timezone.label: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA timezone for the date filters, e.g. "Asia/Singapore". Defaults to UTC.

ordering.label: Ordering
ordering.description: Sort field; a leading "-" sorts descending.

includeResult.label: Include Result
includeResult.description: "true" adds each document's parsed data as a JSON string in "result". Defaults to "false".

page.label: Page
page.description: Page number to return, starting at 1. Defaults to 1. The response's "total" is the number of pages.

documentId.label: Document ID
documentId.description: ID of the document: the numeric "id" from List Documents, or the DocumentID the upload actions return.

parseur_upload_email_document.description: Sends an email or text document into a mailbox for parsing.

aiEngine.label: AI Engine
aiEngine.description: Parsing engine. DISABLED uses templates only; GCP_AI_2, GCP_AI_3_TXT and GCP_AI_4 are AI engines (Get Option Values lists them with labels).

aiInstructions.label: AI Instructions
aiInstructions.description: General instructions the AI engine follows for every document in this mailbox.

emailPrefix.label: Email Prefix
emailPrefix.description: Part before "@in.parseur.com" in the mailbox's email address. Must be unique across Parseur.

fields.label: Fields
fields.description: The mailbox's fields to extract, as a JSON array of objects: {"name": "InvoiceNumber", "format": "ONELINE", "query": "The invoice number"}. format is one of TEXT, ONELINE, DATE, TIME, DATETIME, NUMBER, NAME, ADDRESS, TABLE, LINK. To keep an existing field, include it with its "id" from Get Mailbox.

additionalFields.label: Additional Settings
additionalFields.description: Other mailbox settings as a JSON object, using Parseur's field names, e.g. {"retention_policy": 30, "process_attachments": true}. The dedicated inputs override the same keys here.
